entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.9.0
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.9.0** - New **Hi-Fi** look (the fifth on the LOOK selector, from PotentialBox): walnut cheeks, a brushed charcoal faceplate, raised panels, domed knobs lit in the plugin's colour, moulded cream keys and green glass displays. - The LOOK selector now has five looks: Print Plate, Night Rack, Colour Block, Vintage and Hi-Fi.

entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.8.0
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.8.0** - **A fourth look: Vintage.** A late-80s drum machine: warm grey panel, cream keys with a hard shadow, an amber display, and PotentialBreaks's own colour for what's selected. It is Potential1200's look, now in the whole PotentialSuite. Pick it with the LOOK keys on the SETTINGS (or SETUP) page; Print Plate stays the default.

entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.7.0
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.7.0** - **MP3 breaks.** MP3 files in your DRUM BREAKS LIBRARY are found and played like WAV and FLAC (the first 3 minutes of a long file, as before). Tempo from the file name works the same: `Funky Drummer 101bpm.mp3`. Tap **RESCAN** after adding some. - Sound, controls and saved projects are unchanged. **Downloads** - **`PotentialBreaks-1.7.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.6.0
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.6.0** - **MANUAL page.** The plugin's manual is now on the MPC's screen: tap **MANUAL**, then the page buttons along the top (what it does, the controls, how it works with the other PotentialSuite plugins, and good-to-know notes). The full PotentialSuite manual is on the [PotentialSuite page](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/potential-plugins). - One parameter was added at the end of the list (Manual Page); saved projects open as before. Sound and controls are unchanged.

entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.5.0
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.5.0** - **BROWSE page**: pick the exact break you want. It lists the breaks in the current library 10 at a time; tap a name to load it. **PAGE UP** / **PAGE DOWN** move through the list, **LIBRARY** switches folders without loading anything, and the break that's playing is lit. It opens on the page with the current break. - Two pages now: BREAKS (as before) and BROWSE. entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.4.0
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.4.0** - **ROLL**: one tap for a random break played a random way. **MILD** chops it on the grid, in order. **MEDIUM** may also chop on the HITS, change the loop length, shuffle the pads and move the pitch a little. **WILD** shuffles every time, can switch the tempo mode and pitches up to 7 semitones either way. RANDOM BREAK still just picks a break. - **GRID chop now always cuts on the beat.** Before, a loop that wasn't 1, 2, 4 or 8 bars long was cut into 8 or 16 equal pieces

entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.3.0
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.3.0** - **SAVE KIT**: one tap saves the 16 pads as a real **MPC drum program**: each pad as a WAV, as you hear it (at your tempo, pitch and shuffle), on pads A01-A16, with the groove as a MIDI file beside it. Load it like any program, and keep it after the plugin is gone. It goes to `PotentialBreaks/Kits` on your breaks' drive, or to the folder named on the first line of `PotentialBreaks/kit-folder.txt` there. entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.2.0
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.2.0** - **Three looks.** A new default look, **Print Plate** (a warm printed panel), plus **Night Rack** (dark rack unit) and **Colour Block** (flat, big type), each in PotentialBreaks's own colour. Pick one with the big LOOK keys on the SETTINGS page; it shows the next time the plugin loads (take it off and add it again, or load your project again), and it is remembered on your MPC for every project. - Sound, controls and saved projects are unchanged. One parameter was added
